note: Converted from the pre-migration personal corpus's scripts/routing-corpus.json (positives/negatives) into harness's cases schema as part of the color plugin port. Re-derived 2026-07-06 for the color-contrast-facts extraction (T4 of the color-science split; see .claude/docs/color-science-extraction-plan.md). Positives span four phrasing classes: APCA/WCAG picks, contrast ratios/relative luminance, low-vision/readable color choices, CVD simulation/safe pairs; each class also carries an imperative/diagnostic/symptom/indirect mix. Negatives drawn adversarially from live neighbors: check-colors (verify/prove asks MUST NOT land here), check-focus (focus-ring contrast), color-space-facts (space/gamut math), color-perception-facts (vision science beyond CVD), color-material-facts (pigment/print), make-palette (building), color-theory-facts (harmony). Reciprocals added 2026-07-09: measurement asks (check/verify a given pair or palette) belong to check-colors — third-strike confirmed boundary across three blind runs. KNOWN AMBIGUOUS SEAM (2026-07-09, 4 blind runs): t05/t06/t08/t10/t12 flip between this pack and check-colors/make-palette BY JUDGE — single-pair measurement and small generative asks sit exactly on the truthful vocabulary boundary, and either owner answers correctly in production. Expectations restored to this pack's original claim; treat flips on these five as accepted, never tune either description to chase them.
